subject: Re: Sprint freeze — trial extension request (Helixa)
messages:
From: Amy Torres <amy@helixa.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Helixa: blocked by SDK freeze — request for trial extension

Hi Aditya / Marissa,

Quick summary: our engineering team hit an unexpected SDK change in v2.1.4 this morning that broke the connector used by our QA pipeline. The devs are in a code freeze until we get a backwards-compatible patch, and that has pushed our demo / evaluation milestones out by at least two weeks.

We were planning to complete our production validation this week and move to a paid seat, but with the freeze we won't have anything to show the execs for the scheduled review on Oct 28.

Request: would Redwood be able to (a) extend our trial window by 14 days and (b) provide a small top-up of free credits so our automated tests and a final scripted demo can run once we unfreeze? Even a short runway would keep momentum.

I've attached the initial build log that shows the failing adapter (build_failed_log.txt).

Appreciate any help — happy to hop on a call to walk through error traces.

Thanks,
Amy Torres
VP Product, Helixa
amy@helixa.io
+1 415-555-0124

Attachment: build_failed_log.txt (text/plain, 180KB)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Amy Torres <amy@helixa.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 14 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Helixa: blocked by SDK freeze — request for trial extension

Hi Amy — thanks for the note and for the log. Sorry to hear about the freeze.

Short answer: we can help. Proposed immediate steps:
- I'll provision a 14-day trial extension on your account (starts today) to give you the runway for the demo.
- As a one-time make-good, we can add a 5,000 token credit to the account now so your CI and scripted demo can run without interruption.

Before I finalize, two asks:
1) Can you confirm the account id / org name you want the extension applied to?
2) Please share the reproducible minimal failing snippet (or give us a 30–45 min window for a joint debugging call).

I've attached a short runbook that often helps with the connector failure path (helpful_runbook.pdf). If you need more credits beyond the 5k, I'll need manager approval — looping Ben and Marissa on that.

Available for a call this afternoon between 1:00–3:00pm PT if that works.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai

Attachment: helpful_runbook.pdf (application/pdf, 420KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 15 Oct 2026 08:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Helixa: blocked by SDK freeze — request for trial extension

Aditya — thanks for jumping on this.

I'm fine with the 14-day extension and the initial 5k credit as a temporary concession to keep the evaluation moving. For any additional credits or a larger one-time grant we'll need formal approval (Ben, see below). Also recommend we open a short CS ticket so our onboarding engineer can be in the joint debug call — I'll create that and add Amy.

HubSpot: I updated the deal notes (see link) with the request and status so our revenue ops has a record. If Amy confirms the org id, I'll kick off the amendment paperwork.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai

Related: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 16 Oct 2026 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Helixa: blocked by SDK freeze — request for trial extension

Thanks team — approved with limits.

Decision: grant a 14-day extension to Helixa (account: Helixa Inc, account id 67890) and add a 5,000-token one-time credit now. We will not commit additional free credits at this stage; if the team can demonstrate the integration milestone (connector passes end-to-end QA and a demo recording is provided) we'll reassess and can consider a follow-on grant.

Action items for sales:
- Aditya: apply extension and credit, confirm to Amy and copy CS ticket id when created.
- Marissa: create the CS ticket and prepare the onboarding engineer for the joint debugging session.
- Ops: prepare a short amendment doc to record the extension (I attached the approval doc).

I've uploaded the signed approval memo: approved_extension_amendment.docx
DocuSign template: https://www.docusign.com/templates/NDX-4487

—Ben
Ben Carter
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

From: Amy Torres <amy@helixa.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Helixa Dev <dev@helixa.io>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 16:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Helixa: blocked by SDK freeze — request for trial extension

Aditya / Marissa — thanks, this is perfect and appreciated. Confirming Helixa accepts the 14-day extension and the 5,000 token credit. Account: Helixa Inc (67890).

We booked the joint debug slot for Wednesday 10/21 10:00am PT and the devs will share a short reproduction repo before then. Can you please confirm when the extension and credit are active so I can unblock the automation? Also, do we need a signed amendment before the trial window is adjusted or can you apply the extension first and follow with DocuSign?

Thanks again — huge help.
Amy
VP Product, Helixa
